title: Step
description: Single executable step or control-flow block.

oneOf.title: invoke
oneOf.description: Invokes an invocable or runnable resource.

oneOf.title: if/then/else
oneOf.description: Conditional branch; executes then or else based on a boolean expression.

if.title: If
if.description: CEL boolean expression; true executes then, false executes else.

elseif.title: Else If
elseif.description: Additional condition-branch pairs evaluated when if is false.

if.title: If
if.description: CEL boolean expression for this else-if branch.

then.title: Then
then.description: Steps executed when this else-if condition is true.

then.title: Then
then.description: Steps executed when if evaluates true.

else.title: Else
else.description: Steps executed when if (and all elseif conditions) evaluate false.

oneOf.title: while/do
oneOf.description: Loop; executes do steps repeatedly while condition is true.

while.title: While
while.description: CEL boolean expression; evaluated before each iteration.

oneOf.title: switch/cases/default
oneOf.description: Multi-branch dispatch; matches a value expression against case keys.

switch.title: Switch
switch.description: CEL expression; result matched against case keys.

cases.title: Cases
cases.description: Map of value to step list; executed when switch matches the key.

default.title: Default
default.description: Steps executed when no case matches.

oneOf.title: try/catch/finally
oneOf.description: Error boundary; executes try steps and handles failure via catch and finally.

when.title: When
when.description: CEL boolean guard — the whole try/catch/finally is skipped when it evaluates false.

try.title: Try
try.description: Steps executed; halts on first failure and jumps to catch.

catch.title: Catch
catch.description: Steps executed when try fails; receives error context.

x-telo-error-context.description: The caught failure (always present inside catch).

code.description: Structured error code; INTERNAL_ERROR for plain errors.

step.description: Name of the step that threw.

data.description: Structured payload from an InvokeError, else undefined.

finally.title: Finally
finally.description: Steps always executed after try/catch regardless of outcome.

x-telo-error-context.description: The caught failure, or null when try (and catch) succeeded.

code.description: Structured error code; INTERNAL_ERROR for plain errors.

step.description: Name of the step that threw.

data.description: Structured payload from an InvokeError, else undefined.

oneOf.title: throw
oneOf.description: Throws an InvokeError unconditionally. Works inside catch blocks via CEL (e.g. code set to `!cel "error.code"`).

throw.title: Throw
throw.description: InvokeError descriptor; code is required, message/data optional.

code.title: Code
code.description: Structured error code; uppercase SNAKE_CASE by convention.

message.title: Message
message.description: Human-readable error message. Defaults to `code` when omitted.

data.title: Data
data.description: Optional structured payload attached to the error.

oneOf.title: value
oneOf.description: Computes a value and publishes it as `steps.<name>.result`, with no dispatch — no resource, no span, no topology node. For an intermediate derived from an earlier step: reshape a response, total some rows, build the next call's inputs.

value.title: Value
value.description: A CEL expression — or a structure (map / array) with `!cel` leaves — evaluated in the step scope: `inputs`, the results of the steps before it, and whatever the enclosing kind binds (`item` / `index` / `items`, `iteration` / `previous`).
